name: Slime Rancher 2
description: Ranch the Rainbow Island together. Ranching Together shares the host's world with up to a few friends: the same slimes, plorts, gardens and ranch, with everyone playing at once.

setup.title: Slime Rancher 2
setup.detail: Install Slime Rancher 2 from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it, and MelonLoader which it runs on, in the game's folder.

setup.title: Starlight
setup.detail: The mod needs Starlight 4.0.3, which its author does not allow to be bundled. Download Starlight.dll from github.com/ThatFinnDev/Starlight/releases/tag/v4.0.3 and put it in the Mods folder of the game.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts it and MelonLoader in the game's folder. Download Starlight.dll from its author's page (see the setup list) into the game's Mods folder.
Press Play. The first start with MelonLoader takes a few minutes while it prepares the game's files.
Join the save you want to play on and configure the mod in its first-time settings screen.
Open the multiplayer menu on the main menu to host, and share your address with your friends.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, and Starlight 4.0.3 into the game's Mods folder, then press Play.
Join an EMPTY save file: everything on the save you join with is erased and replaced by the host's world. Always use that save to join this host.
Open the multiplayer menu on the main menu and connect to the host's address.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: The host's save is the one played on; friends join it. Everyone needs the same version of the mod, of MelonLoader and of Starlight.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod and MelonLoader in the game's folder and updates them when a new version is released.

items.name: Shared world
items.detail: Slimes, plorts, gardens and the ranch are kept in step between players.

items.name: Players
items.detail: Other players are shown in the world.
